title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 近年来,越来越多的年轻人喜爱各种形式的自助旅游。许多自助旅游者选择徒步或骑自行车出游。他们自己设计路线,自带帐篷、厨具以及其他必备的生活用品。在旅途中,自助旅游者经常能够发现一些新的美丽景点,但有时也会遇见意想不到的困难或突发事件。游客在旅行中拥抱自然、欣赏美景,同时也增强了自己克服困难的勇气和野外生存的能力。
reference: In recent years, more and more young people have become fond of various forms of self-guided travel. Many self-guided travelers choose to travel on foot or by bike. They design their own routes and bring their own tents, cooking utensils and other daily necessities. During their trips, they often discover some beautiful new scenic spots, but they sometimes encounter unexpected difficulties or emergencies. While embracing nature and enjoying the beautiful scenery, travelers also build up their courage to overcome difficulties and their ability to survive in the wild.
